subject: Skyline On-Prem Integration: activation evidence and gating questions
messages:
From: Alice Ng <alice.ng@skyline.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 24 Nov 2028 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: On-prem integration kickoff: required evidence & questions

Marcus / Ben / Kim,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday — Skyline is aiming to lock the activation window for our on-prem Tenant (project: Skyline-Prod-Tenant) in the week of Dec 4. Before we confirm, we need to collect the following items so our network & security teams can sign the gate: 

- Full network diagram showing peering, NAT devices, firewall zones and transit (visual + text).
- Egress IP list(s) for token validation and allowlisting.
- Intended BGP / routing approach (static vs. BGP; ASN if applicable).
- Confirmation of MTU and recommended interconnect throughput for 100k TPS test.
- KMS integration pattern: will you use customer-managed keys or Redwood-managed KMS?
- Any required firewall port allowlist (TCP/UDP/ports) for health checks, telemetry, and control-plane.

We have a draft checklist attached for you to annotate (see attached: skyline-egress-request-template.csv). Also please let us know if you can take a 45-minute technical validation call next Tuesday or Wednesday (Nov 28/29) to walk through the diagrams and any outstanding security questions.

Two quick constraints from our side: we require (1) explicit egress IPs for doc signing and webhook callbacks, and (2) telem data retention confirmation (30/90/365-day options).

Appreciate a response with the items you can supply by EOD Monday (Nov 27) so we can keep the Dec 4 target.

Best,

Alice Ng
Platform PM — Integrations
Skyline Health

Attachment: skyline-egress-request-template.csv (CSV — 1KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Ng <alice.ng@skyline.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 24 Nov 2028 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: On-prem integration kickoff: required evidence & questions

Alice — thanks for the clear list. We can provide everything you've asked for; below is an initial mapping of items and owners so the team knows what to expect. I attached a short "networking delta" doc that highlights the changes for the Skyline tenant compared to our standard private-deploy baseline.

Checklist (what we'll deliver):
- Network diagram + peering configuration: Marcus (attachment: redwood_networking_delta_plan.pdf)
- Egress IPs: Ben will confirm final /28 set by Nov 27 (we'll attach CSV)
- Routing: we recommend using static routing for the first phase; BGP optional for cross-site peering (we'll document ASN + examples).
- MTU & throughput guidance: we'll provide recommended MTU of 1500 and baseline interconnect sizing guidance for 10Gbps (with notes for burst testing).
- KMS: Skyline can choose customer-managed keys (recommended for compliance). We'll provide our KMS integration runbook and sample IAM policies.
- Firewall allowlist: we'll share a staged allowlist (control-plane, telemetry, health-checks).

Proposed times for the 45-minute validation call: Tue Nov 28 11:00–11:45 PT or Wed Nov 29 09:00–09:45 PT. Please confirm which works for Skyline infra.

Action items for Redwood before the call:
1) Attach delta doc (done).
2) Finalize egress IPs (Ben).
3) Draft KMS runbook excerpt (Kim).

I'll coordinate an invite once we have a slot.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_networking_delta_plan.pdf (PDF — 180KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Ng <alice.ng@skyline.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 25 Nov 2028 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: On-prem integration kickoff: required evidence & questions

Quick technical note — on egress IPs and routing:
- We're provisionally reserving 3 /29s for Skyline for stage/prod/qa. Final /28 will be confirmed by EOD Monday.
- For the Dec 4 activation, please confirm whether your appliance supports asymmetric return routing; if not, we'll advise an explicit NAT+SNAT pattern.
- For BGP: if you want dynamic routing we can announce a dedicated prefix and handle ASN exchanges (we'll need your ASN and an uptime SLA for the peering session).

I'll include a simple sample iptables/ACL snippet in the meeting to speed the config.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Infrastructure Lead — Private Deploy
Redwood Inference

From: Dave Cho <dave.cho@skyline.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Ng <alice.ng@skyline.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 26 Nov 2028 08:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: On-prem integration kickoff: required evidence & questions

Marcus / Ben — thanks. Attached is the initial egress IP list (skyline_egress_ips.csv) and our answers inline below: 

- MTU: our appliances are standard 1500, but we will test 9000 if you recommend jumbo frames for throughput.
- ASN: Skyline ASN 64512 (private ASN) — we can run BGP if Redwood supports that out of the box.
- Telem retention: we currently store telemetry for 90 days; for production we can extend to 365 days if required (we need a cost impact estimate).
- KMS: Skyline prefers customer-managed keys (we use AWS KMS). We'll share the KMS ARN in the call.

We're available for Tue Nov 28 at 11:00 PT — please send the invite. Also, one question: for the activation gate, do you require signed evidence of firewall rule changes (signed PDF) or will a recorded meeting + drive evidence suffice?

Cheers,

Dave Cho
Principal Infrastructure Engineer
Skyline Health

Attachment: skyline_egress_ips.csv (CSV — 2KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Ng <alice.ng@skyline.ai>, Dave Cho <dave.cho@skyline.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 27 Nov 2028 16:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: On-prem integration kickoff: required evidence & questions

Team — after reviewing the attachments and our internal runbook, Redwood considers Skyline ready to proceed to the activation gating checklist pending the following (we can sign off once these are completed):

1) Final egress /28 block confirmed and uploaded to the shared Drive (we have the CSV; we'll accept that as official).
2) KMS ARN and confirmation of IAM cross-account policy (we'll provide example policy; customer-managed keys accepted).
3) Recorded 45-minute validation call with the network and security owners present (we will mark that recording as evidence in the gate).
4) A signed PDF of firewall change requests OR an internal change ticket that references the Drive evidence (either is fine; if using a ticket, include the ticket URL).

If these items are complete, Redwood will execute the activation runbook and coordinate a 4-hour on-call window on Dec 4 (03:00–07:00 PT) for the final cutover. Please confirm acceptance of the window and attach the KMS ARN and ticket/PDF by EOD Nov 30.

I'll create the gate checklist in the shared Drive and send a link.

Thanks — Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Lead Product Security Engineer — Private Deploy
Redwood Inference

Related link: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/Skyline-Onprem-Integration-Docs
Attachment: vpc_peering_template.yaml (YAML — 3KB)
